title: StarRocks cluster-status: 3 FE quorum + 3 BE
description: Introspects the live StarRocks cluster the way the nexus-cli StarRocksAdapter cluster-status verb will: SHOW FRONTENDS (1 LEADER + 2 FOLLOWER, BDB-JE quorum) + SHOW BACKENDS (3 alive). Over SSH+mysql until the adapter lands.

observe.what: 3 FE rows: 1 Role=LEADER + 2 Role=FOLLOWER, all Alive=true -- the BDB-JE majority quorum (ADR-0030)
3 BE rows all Alive=true; TabletNum > 0 on each (tablets distributed across all 3 BE)

whatProves: cluster-status reports the genuine FE quorum (1 leader + 2 followers) + 3 alive BE -- the introspection sources the StarRocksAdapter reads (SHOW FRONTENDS / SHOW BACKENDS over the MySQL protocol).
